description: This file defines the AppTheme class for configuring the application's visual theme using Flutter's Material 3 components. It includes methods for generating a color scheme, theme data with specific styling for UI components, and a background gradient decoration, all adhering to the Ocean Professional palette.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing theme configurations and styling for the app, including color schemes, theme data, and background gradients.

methods.name: colorScheme
methods.description: Generates a ColorScheme object using the Ocean Professional palette with primary, secondary, error, surface, and other color definitions.

methods.name: themeData
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ThemeData object configured with the Ocean color scheme and styling for app bar, cards, snack bars, dialogs, inputs, and buttons.

methods.name: pageBackgroundGradient
methods.description: Provides a BoxDecoration with a subtle linear gradient for page backgrounds.
